episodes.label: Shadows, Sound, and Spin — Human Musculoskeletal Radiography & Occult Fractures (H031), Veterinary Allometric Echocardiography & EPIC/TMT Cohorts (V015) & Brain/Spinal Neuro-MRI (V017)
episodes.notes: One Medicine synthesis of human musculoskeletal radiography (H031), veterinary echocardiography (V015), and veterinary neuro-MRI (V017): Ottawa rules, occult scaphoid/hip cohorts, 10-14 day osteomyelitis lag, and 21-view forensic surveys; allometric cardiac scaling (BW^0.294), EPIC (n=360), feline Transient Myocardial Thickening (n=21), and Doppler 4V^2 math; and Ito's 71-dog myelomalacia prognostic rule, post-ictal piriform mimics, dorsal microchip voids, and pre-CSF herniation checks.
episodes.full_label: Shadows, Sound, and Spin — Human Musculoskeletal Radiography & Occult Fractures (H031), Veterinary Allometric Echocardiography & EPIC/TMT Cohorts (V015) & Brain/Spinal Neuro-MRI (V017)
episodes.short_label: Shadows, Sound, and Spin

episodes.label: What the Section and the Scatter Saw — Tissue Biopsy, Cold Ischemia & Margin Geometry (H029), Flow Cytometry Clonality, MRD & Lineage Switch (H030) & Veterinary Helical CT Staging (V016)
episodes.notes: One Medicine synthesis of tissue histopathology (H029), multiparameter flow cytometry (H030), and veterinary helical CT (V016): cold ischemia, formalin kinetics, Elmore's 240x115 breast biopsy concordance and STR floater checks; MBL, TRBC1, COG/EuroFlow MRD, and anti-CD19 lineage switch; and canine lung staging (41/459 nodules on X-ray), breath-hold recruitment, 66-dog portosystemic shunt CTA, and caval tumor-thrombus mapping.
episodes.full_label: What the Section and the Scatter Saw — Tissue Biopsy, Cold Ischemia & Margin Geometry (H029), Flow Cytometry Clonality, MRD & Lineage Switch (H030) & Veterinary Helical CT Staging (V016)
episodes.short_label: What the Section and the Scatter Saw — Tissue Biopsy

episodes.label: What the Surface Sample Missed — Cervical Cytology & Self-Collected HPV Trials (H028), Canine & Feline Tissue Biopsy Margins (V019) & Deep vs. Surface Skin Scrapings (V032)
episodes.notes: One Medicine epithelial, mucosal, and surgical pathology deep dive (H028, V019, V032): ASCCP unsatisfactory vs. absent-TZ rules, 2025 SELF-CERV vaginal HPV trial (n=599), HPV FOCAL (n=19,009), European pooled RCTs (n=176,464), English HPV vaccine registry (13.7M person-years), gastric-type adenocarcinoma missed by cone biopsy, Kemp (2015) 70-dog liver biopsy concordance (60%-69%), Marsilio (2019) 12/20 healthy cats called small-cell lymphoma on IHC/PARR, 2026 32-dog STS biopsy undergrading, 94-dog STS 3-year margin recurrence (41.2%/22.5%/7.1%), Barillas (2019) demodicosis hair-pluck vs. deep-scrape monitoring, Díaz (2023) post-cure Malassezia qPCR persistence, and Bizikova (2019) 35-cat pemphigus foliaceus relapses (24/31).
episodes.full_label: What the Surface Sample Missed — Cervical Cytology & Self-Collected HPV Trials (H028), Canine & Feline Tissue Biopsy Margins (V019) & Deep vs. Surface Skin Scrapings (V032)
episodes.short_label: What the Surface Sample Missed

episodes.label: What the Sequence Cannot Say Alone — Germline Exomes & Genomes (H026), Karyotypes vs. Microarrays & Mosaicism (H027) & Veterinary Bone Marrow Architecture (V020)
episodes.notes: One Medicine genomic, cytogenetic, and hematopoietic pathology synthesis (H026, H027, V020): DeRoin (2022) 350-patient fibroblast vs. blood germline testing, Manrai (2016) ancestry reference bias, Project Baby Bear (184 NICU infants), Bagnall (2016) 490 sudden cardiac deaths, Wapner (2012) 4,406 prenatal microarrays, Reddy (2012) 532 stillbirths, Halgren (2018) 17-year balanced rearrangements, Pallister-Killian buccal vs. blood mosaicism, feline vs. canine marrow iron stores, 2026 two-site canine marrow concordance, canine PIMA rubriphagocytosis (61/66), reversible feline B12 pancytopenia, and the 2021 UK 580-cat pancytopenia outbreak.
episodes.full_label: What the Sequence Cannot Say Alone — Germline Exomes & Genomes (H026), Karyotypes vs. Microarrays & Mosaicism (H027) & Veterinary Bone Marrow Architecture (V020)
episodes.short_label: What the Sequence Cannot Say Alone — Germline Exomes & Genomes

episodes.label: Precession, Echoes, and Chamber Geometry — Human MRI Spin Physics, Macrocyclic Gadolinium & PRECISION/WAKE-UP Trials (H033), Diagnostic & Bedside Ultrasound Cutoffs (H034) & Hemodynamic Echocardiography (H035)
episodes.notes: Clinical Cluster & Diagnostic Physics synthesis of human MRI (H033), diagnostic/bedside ultrasonography (H034), and hemodynamic echocardiography (H035): Larmor spin physics, DWI/ADC shine-through, macrocyclic gadolinium safety (0/4,931 NSF), legacy pacemaker MRI (2,103 scans), PRECISION/WAKE-UP trials, and asymptomatic spine/knee cascades; 1,540 m/s range calibration, carotid string-sign paradox, Doubilet first-trimester safety cutoffs, STONE (n=2,759), and Pivetta lung ultrasound (n=1,005); and Simpson LVEF, SUCCOUR GLS, Bernoulli/Continuity valve math, RECOVERY (n=145), TTE vs. TEE endocarditis, tamponade, and acute PE.
episodes.full_label: Precession, Echoes, and Chamber Geometry — Human MRI Spin Physics, Macrocyclic Gadolinium & PRECISION/WAKE-UP Trials (H033), Diagnostic & Bedside Ultrasound Cutoffs (H034) & Hemodynamic Echocardiography (H035)
episodes.short_label: Precession, Echoes, and Chamber Geometry

episodes.label: The Dose the Liver Had to Finish — Clopidogrel Thienopyridine Prodrug Bioactivation, CYP2C19 Loss-of-Function Alleles, Rapid GMEX Genotyping & the CHANCE-2 Trial
episodes.notes: Behind the Curtain Pharmacology investigation of clopidogrel (Plavix) hepatic two-step CYP2C19 bioactivation vs. CES1 esterase hydrolysis: why CYP2C19*2/*3 loss-of-function alleles leave platelets uninhibited, point-of-care GMEX genotyping validation, CPIC clinical guidelines, and the CHANCE-2 ticagrelor-vs.-clopidogrel stroke trial.
episodes.full_label: The Dose the Liver Had to Finish — Clopidogrel Thienopyridine Prodrug Bioactivation, CYP2C19 Loss-of-Function Alleles, Rapid GMEX Genotyping & the CHANCE-2 Trial
episodes.short_label: The Dose the Liver Had to Finish

episodes.label: The Same Breakfast, Different Curves — PREDICT 1 Postprandial Glycemic & Lipemic Variability, Interstitial Glucose Oxidase (1CF3), Dual-CGM Discordance & Trial Outcomes
episodes.notes: From PREDICT 1 (Berry et al. 2020, n=1,002) inter-individual postprandial glucose and triglyceride variability to glucose oxidase FAD electrochemistry (PDB 1CF3), simultaneous same-brand vs. cross-brand CGM meal ranking discordance (Merino 2022; Hengist 2025 inpatient duplicate meals), and the Personal Diet Study vs. METHOD randomized trials.
episodes.full_label: The Same Breakfast, Different Curves — PREDICT 1 Postprandial Glycemic & Lipemic Variability, Interstitial Glucose Oxidase (1CF3), Dual-CGM Discordance & Trial Outcomes
episodes.short_label: The Same Breakfast, Different Curves

episodes.label: The Bile Acid That Missed the Return Trip — Ileal ASBT Reclamation, FXR–FGF19–CYP7A1 Feedback (6HL1), 75SeHCAT Retention, Serum C4 & SINBAD Trial
episodes.notes: Enterohepatic circulation and bile acid malabsorption: apical sodium-dependent bile acid transporter (ASBT/SLC10A2), human FXR ligand-binding domain (PDB 6HL1), ileal FGF19 suppression of hepatic CYP7A1, 7-day 75SeHCAT gamma retention vs. fasting serum 7alpha-hydroxy-4-cholesten-3-one (C4), and colesevelam sequestration in the SINBAD trial.
episodes.full_label: The Bile Acid That Missed the Return Trip — Ileal ASBT Reclamation, FXR–FGF19–CYP7A1 Feedback (6HL1), 75SeHCAT Retention, Serum C4 & SINBAD Trial
episodes.short_label: The Bile Acid That Missed the Return Trip

episodes.label: The Leucine That Wouldn’t Clear — Maple Syrup Urine Disease, BCKDH E1 Phosphorylation (1DTW/1OLS), Isobaric LC-MS/MS Alloisoleucine & Liver Transplant Flux
episodes.notes: Biochemical and analytical dissection of Maple Syrup Urine Disease (MSUD) decompensation: human BCKDH E1 alpha-ketoacid decarboxylation and BCKDK Ser292 phosphorylation (PDB 1DTW/1OLS/4H7Q), chromatographic separation of isobaric leucine, isoleucine, alloisoleucine, and hydroxyproline at m/z 132->86, LAT1 blood-brain barrier competition, IV BCAA-free rescue, and liver transplantation.
episodes.full_label: The Leucine That Wouldn’t Clear — Maple Syrup Urine Disease, BCKDH E1 Phosphorylation (1DTW/1OLS), Isobaric LC-MS/MS Alloisoleucine & Liver Transplant Flux
episodes.short_label: The Leucine That Wouldn’t Clear — Maple Syrup Urine Disease

episodes.label: The Blue Dye & the Oxygen Number — Methylene Blue, Acquired Methemoglobinemia, Two-Wavelength SpO2 vs. Co-Oximetry & G6PD Limits
episodes.notes: How an industrial phenothiazine dye became the antidote for acquired methemoglobinemia—and why both ferric methemoglobin (660/940 nm) and intravenous methylene blue itself spoof two-wavelength pulse oximeters toward an ~85% plateau while multiwavelength co-oximetry separates fractional species.
episodes.full_label: The Blue Dye & the Oxygen Number — Methylene Blue, Acquired Methemoglobinemia, Two-Wavelength SpO2 vs. Co-Oximetry & G6PD Limits
episodes.short_label: The Blue Dye & the Oxygen Number — Methylene Blue

episodes.label: The Pressure Behind the Reading — Human Bilateral Topiramate Angle-Closure Glaucoma (H052), Feline Post-Traumatic Hypotony & Lens Rupture (V033), Applanation vs. Rebound Tonometry & Ocular Ultrasound
episodes.notes: One Medicine ophthalmic tonometry and structural imaging comparison (H052 & V033): Al-Naqeeb et al. (2021) bilateral topiramate ciliochoroidal effusion with 55/58 mmHg angle closure resolved by cycloplegia and drug cessation rather than iridotomy, Ricci et al. (2024) feline rebound vs. applanation tonometry bias across IOP ranges, and Klever et al. (2025) ocular ultrasound of feline scleral and lens rupture masked by hyphema.
episodes.full_label: The Pressure Behind the Reading — Human Bilateral Topiramate Angle-Closure Glaucoma (H052), Feline Post-Traumatic Hypotony & Lens Rupture (V033), Applanation vs. Rebound Tonometry & Ocular Ultrasound
episodes.short_label: The Pressure Behind the Reading

episodes.label: The Potassium That Rose in the Tube — Reverse Pseudohyperkalemia in Leukocytosis, Pneumatic Tube Shear vs. Hand-Carried Whole Blood, Cold-Induced ABCB6 Leak & ECG Sensitivity Traps
episodes.notes: Dissecting in-vitro potassium artifacts before the analyzer: Mansoor et al. (2015) reverse pseudohyperkalemia (9.5 mmol/L across three analyzers vs. 3.7 mmol/L on hand-carried whole blood due to pneumatic-tube mechanical lysis of fragile leukemic white cells in heparinized plasma), Xiong et al. (2022) familial cold-induced ABCB6 red-cell potassium leak, and Raffee et al. (2022) why a normal ECG cannot rule out true hyperkalemia.
episodes.full_label: The Potassium That Rose in the Tube — Reverse Pseudohyperkalemia in Leukocytosis, Pneumatic Tube Shear vs. Hand-Carried Whole Blood, Cold-Induced ABCB6 Leak & ECG Sensitivity Traps
episodes.short_label: The Potassium That Rose in the Tube

episodes.label: The Blood Type That Was Missing — Canine Dal Red-Cell Antigen Discovery, Day-40 Post-Transfusion Alloimmunization, Goulet Breed Prevalence & Severe Anemia Typing-Card Limits
episodes.notes: Behind the Curtain veterinary transfusion investigation: how a Dalmatian compatible with two Borzoi donors at day 0 agglutinated all 55 non-Dalmatian donors by day 40, revealing the autosomal-dominant Dal erythrocyte antigen, Goulet et al. (2017) breed prevalence, and Veran/Blais (2023) cage-side typing card agglutination limits in severely anemic dogs.
episodes.full_label: The Blood Type That Was Missing — Canine Dal Red-Cell Antigen Discovery, Day-40 Post-Transfusion Alloimmunization, Goulet Breed Prevalence & Severe Anemia Typing-Card Limits
episodes.short_label: The Blood Type That Was Missing

episodes.label: How Scientists Recorded a Single Ion Channel — Katz & Miledi's Acetylcholine Noise Variance, Neher & Sakmann's 1976 Frog Muscle Pipette Steps & Hamill's Gigaseal Configurations
episodes.notes: From statistical fluctuation analysis to direct single-molecule electrophysiology: Katz & Miledi (1972) inferring elementary acetylcholine events from voltage noise, Neher & Sakmann (1976) resolving discrete ~2.2 pA square current steps across a micro-patch of denervated frog muscle, and Hamill et al. (1981) gigaohm glass-membrane seals enabling cell-attached, whole-cell, inside-out, and outside-out configurations.
episodes.full_label: How Scientists Recorded a Single Ion Channel — Katz & Miledi's Acetylcholine Noise Variance, Neher & Sakmann's 1976 Frog Muscle Pipette Steps & Hamill's Gigaseal Configurations
episodes.short_label: How Scientists Recorded a Single Ion Channel

episodes.label: Photons, Thresholds, and Tracers — Mammography, Tomosynthesis & Dense-Breast Screening (H036), DXA Bone Density, Spondylosis Artifacts & NORA/SCOOP Paradoxes (H037) & Nuclear Medicine SPECT/PET-CT Theranostics (H038)
episodes.notes: Clinical Cluster & Diagnostic Physics synthesis of mammography/DBT (H036), DXA bone densitometry (H037), and nuclear medicine SPECT/PET-CT (H038): Friedewald DBT (n=454,850), DENSE MRI (n=40,373), BI-RADS discordance, and 1,000-woman screening funnels; DXA spondylosis false elevation, LSC math, NORA (n=200,160) & SCOOP (n=12,483), and pre-drug osteomalacia screening; and FDG superscans, proPSMA (n=302), SPECT balanced ischemia vs. PET CFR, cold myeloma vs. flare, PIOPED II V/Q, I-131 fetal thyroid protection, and Deauville 1-5.
episodes.full_label: Photons, Thresholds, and Tracers — Mammography, Tomosynthesis & Dense-Breast Screening (H036), DXA Bone Density, Spondylosis Artifacts & NORA/SCOOP Paradoxes (H037) & Nuclear Medicine SPECT/PET-CT Theranostics (H038)

episodes.notes: Separating stool hemoglobin screening, mucosal adduct biology, and observational nutritional epidemiology: FIT buffer-to-feces (µg Hb/g) conversion, human MGMT Cys145 suicidal O6-methylguanine repair (PDB 1EH6/1T38), Le Leu et al. (2015) randomized high-red-meat ± butyrylated resistant starch rectal biopsy O6MeG adduct trial, and gene-by-diet interaction studies.
episodes.full_label: The Colon Cancer Signal in the Diet Survey — Fecal Immunochemical Screening Conversion, MGMT Cys145 Suicide Alkyl Transfer, Le Leu's Red-Meat vs. Butyrylated-Starch Rectal Crypt Biopsies & UK Biobank GxE
episodes.short_label: The Colon Cancer Signal in the Diet Survey

episodes.label: The Allele at the Mediterranean Table — TCF7L2 rs7903146 Islet Chromatin Accessibility, Beta-Catenin 1JPW Interface, PREDIMED Stroke Subgroup & the 2018 Trial Reanalysis
episodes.notes: From intronic TCF7L2 rs7903146 C-to-T open chromatin in human pancreatic islets (Gaulton et al. 2010) and beta-catenin groove binding (PDB 1JPW) to Corella et al.'s (2013) PREDIMED genotype-stratified stroke analysis (n=7,018 / 4,727) and Estruch et al.'s (2018) NEJM retraction-republication accounting for household and clinic non-randomization.
episodes.full_label: The Allele at the Mediterranean Table — TCF7L2 rs7903146 Islet Chromatin Accessibility, Beta-Catenin 1JPW Interface, PREDIMED Stroke Subgroup & the 2018 Trial Reanalysis
episodes.short_label: The Allele at the Mediterranean Table

episodes.label: The Marathon, the Microbe, and the Mouse — Boston Marathon Veillonella atypica Stool Signal, Mouse [13C3]Lactate Gut Crossing, Colorectal Propionate & Human Crossover Trials
episodes.notes: Dissecting the Veillonella atypica exercise-microbiome hypothesis (Scheiman et al. 2019 Nature Medicine vs. human crossover trials): relative 16S stool abundance after the Boston Marathon, IV [13C3]lactate mouse cecal tracing at 17–19 minutes, 32-mouse AB-BA treadmill crossover vs. intrarectal propionate instillation, and human randomized endpoints.
episodes.full_label: The Marathon, the Microbe, and the Mouse — Boston Marathon Veillonella atypica Stool Signal, Mouse [13C3]Lactate Gut Crossing, Colorectal Propionate & Human Crossover Trials
episodes.short_label: The Marathon, the Microbe, and the Mouse

episodes.label: The Monkeys on Two Different Clocks — Wisconsin vs. NIA Rhesus Caloric Restriction Survival, Diet Composition & Feeding Schedules, Sestrin2 5DJ4 & CALERIE
episodes.notes: Reconciling the University of Wisconsin (2009, 2014) and NIA (2012, 2017) rhesus macaque caloric restriction colonies: age at onset, purified 28.5% sucrose ad libitum controls vs. natural-ingredient rationed controls, age-related vs. all-cause Cox hazard ratios, human Sestrin2 leucine-pocket structure (PDB 5DJ4), and the human 2-year CALERIE trial.
episodes.full_label: The Monkeys on Two Different Clocks — Wisconsin vs. NIA Rhesus Caloric Restriction Survival, Diet Composition & Feeding Schedules, Sestrin2 5DJ4 & CALERIE
episodes.short_label: The Monkeys on Two Different Clocks

episodes.label: The Diet That Went First — Ad Libitum Plant-Based Low-Fat vs. Animal Ketogenic Crossover, Day-15 Sequence Carryover & Ketone/GLP-1 Dynamics
episodes.notes: Methodological and physiological dissection of Hall et al. (2021) and Sciarrillo et al. (2024): how comparing within-person low-fat vs. ketogenic intake (-689 kcal/day) differs from comparing randomized 28-day diet orders (-921 kcal/day for ketogenic-first), and how no-washout crossovers entangle current menu with prior diet history.
episodes.full_label: The Diet That Went First — Ad Libitum Plant-Based Low-Fat vs. Animal Ketogenic Crossover, Day-15 Sequence Carryover & Ketone/GLP-1 Dynamics
episodes.short_label: The Diet That Went First

episodes.label: The Water Temple's Calendar — Balinese Subak Irrigation Networks, Lansing & Kremer's Pest-vs.-Water Tradeoff Models & Green Revolution Disruption
episodes.notes: Systems ecology and historical ethnography of Balinese water temples (Lansing 1987, Lansing & Kremer 1993): how ritual cropping calendars balance upstream water scarcity against synchronized fallow pest control, what the 1970s Green Revolution natural experiment revealed, and critiques from historical archival records.
episodes.full_label: The Water Temple's Calendar — Balinese Subak Irrigation Networks, Lansing & Kremer's Pest-vs.-Water Tradeoff Models & Green Revolution Disruption
episodes.short_label: The Water Temple's Calendar — Balinese Subak Irrigation Networks

episodes.notes: Critical audit of the watching-eyes literature from Bateson et al. (2006) breakroom coffee honesty-box study to large-sample preregistered replications and meta-analyses.

episodes.label: The Blank Cell in the Big Gods Debate — Seshat Missing-Data Coding, Chronological Priors & Retraction Reanalysis
